resources.string: Your VPN and phone, measured together. Every recommendation has a real destination.
Local read-only measurements. No file deletion, app changes, network probes or cloud uploads.
Unable to read Android network status.
Storage and KX cache measurement unavailable.
Only launcher apps visible to KX, not a list of every Android package.
This is a local triage dashboard, not antivirus, device-wide cleaning or proof of an IP/DNS leak. Existing services handle reviews, permissions and confirmations.
Measured VPN, network, storage and app status with actionable guidance.
Read-only Guardian scan · approval-based actions in existing services
No saved WireGuard profile is available. Import one from a provider you trust before connecting.
A profile is saved but the VPN tunnel is not active. Connect from Home only when you choose.
The tunnel controller reports an error. Review Security Center before reconnecting.
Do not assume the tunnel is active while connecting or disconnecting. Review session status.
The backend reports a tunnel, but no recent handshake was supplied. This is unknown, not a proven leak.
Android reports no active network. Inspect connectivity before blaming the VPN.
Android reports a captive portal. Review the network login state.
Android has not validated Internet connectivity. This does not by itself prove an outage.
Guardian could not read network state. Open Network Doctor for a focused diagnostic.
The active link returned no DNS servers. This does not establish a DNS leak.
The measured internal volume has at most 10 percent available. Review files before deleting anything.
Guardian could not measure the internal data volume. Open Storage X-Ray for a targeted scan.
KX has measurable cache data. Review candidates first; measured cache size is not guaranteed savings.
App inventory could not be read
Android did not provide a list of visible launcher apps. Review permissions and app inventory.
Inspect launchable apps and their management options. Android must authorize any uninstall.
No actionable issue was found in the measurements available for this scan.
